backup.production_rule: Utility bills, usage tracking and the Today bills card (Lloyd 2026-11-20, mockup v5, contract docs/s127/CONTRACT.md Lane A). Adds app_settings utility_billing (only if absent), utility_bill_estimate_v1 (internal), today_bills_v1 (every active staff role of the property, 42501 otherwise, money by design) and eleven internal helpers (one per-day use helper, utility_daily_use_v1, that the cycle estimate, usage_months and the per-night figures all read, so a reading is spread over the days it covers; a settings read that falls back key by key and never raises; cycle days clamped per month), and replaces kpi_tab_v1 in place behind an md5 guard (s115 body 229c75a34209e1820c3e0209e8d67adf, this release 80efd89e916bcd6107c681baf86f143f; 55000 when the live body is neither) with three added statements: utility.usage_months (no money), admin.bills / rate_year_avg / rate_history / water_rate / stays and admin.rate.checked_at (read_finance only). Every existing key, grant, security setting and search_path of kpi_tab_v1 is unchanged.

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_v1_is_this_release
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '80efd89e916bcd6107c681baf86f143f' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: kpi_tab_v1_grants_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)', 'execute') and (select prosecdef from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure) and (select proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.kpi_tab_v1(uuid,date)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: today_bills_v1_authenticated_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)', 'execute') and (select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.today_bills_v1(uuid)'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: internal_functions_closed
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(not has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.utility_billing_default_v1()', 'public.utility_cfg_num_v1(jsonb,jsonb)', 'public.utility_billing_cfg_v1()', 'public.utility_cycle_day_v1(date,integer)', 'public.utility_daily_use_v1(uuid,date,date)', 'public.utility_cycle_v1(date,integer)', 'public.utility_rate_by_month_v1()', 'public.utility_water_php_v1(numeric,jsonb)', 'public.utility_water_next_v1(numeric,jsonb)', 'public.utility_bill_estimate_v1(uuid,date)', 'public.kpi_usage_months_v1(uuid,date)', 'public.kpi_admin_bills_v1(uuid,numeric)']) f

forward_verification.name: settings_row_present
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.app_settings where key = 'utility_billing') = 1 and (select value -> 'water' ->> 'min_php' from public.app_settings where key = 'utility_billing') = '212'

forward_verification.name: water_tariff_hand_check
forward_verification.query: select public.utility_water_php_v1(10.01, public.utility_billing_cfg_v1()) = 212.23 and public.utility_water_php_v1(20.5, public.utility_billing_cfg_v1()) = 455.83 and public.utility_water_php_v1(45, public.utility_billing_cfg_v1()) = 1186.50

forward_verification.name: cycle_boundaries
forward_verification.query: select public.utility_cycle_v1(date '2026-11-21', 21) = array[date '2026-10-21', date '2026-11-21'] and public.utility_cycle_v1(date '2026-11-22', 21) = array[date '2026-11-21', date '2026-12-21']

rollback.safe_until: Always: the s115 kpi_tab_v1 body goes back and the new functions and the utility_billing setting are dropped. No data of any other table is touched.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261127_s127_utility_bills.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; kpi_tab_v1 must be back to md5 229c75a34209e1820c3e0209e8d67adf. Roll the staff app back first (an old build ignores the extra keys, so either order is safe for it).

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old staff builds keep working: every existing key of kpi_tab_v1 stays and the new keys are additions an old build ignores; today_bills_v1 is only called by the new build.
